messages:
jon: Heads-up: starting a quiet v2 cutover in ~30m. Canary 5% for 1h, then evaluate metrics. Pin window: keep mobile SDKs and top-5 customers on v1 until we confirm. @amanda can you confirm release notes are published?
amanda: Release notes are live in the console and marketplace doc. Short changelog + fallback guidance. Pinged docs team for a micro-fix (typo) but not blocking. :white_check_mark:
priya: Rollback criteria? what exact signal should trigger immediate rollback vs slow-rollback?
jon: Primary triggers: 1) error rate delta > 1.5x baseline sustained for 5m across production routes; 2) 99th latency increase > 250ms vs baseline for >5m; 3) client pins spike > 0.5% of total traffic in the canary slice. If any hit, we stop the rollout and route to v1.
lucas: Add: if p95 generation token cost jumps >20% that's also a soft-trigger to hold and investigate.
sara: For client impact: remind mobile that header signal is case-sensitive. Use `X-Redwood-Api-Version: v2` (lower-case 'v'). We had a client fail last time due to case mismatch.
jon: Good call. We'll include header example in release notes and the console banner. Also enabling a header-normalize proxy on the gateway for the canary to reduce noise.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @jon at 5234569690. Command: `/deploy service=api-gateway version=v2 canary=5% duration=60m pin-list=mobile,top5-clients`
release-bot: preflight checks passed: schema compatibility OK; model-mappings OK; infra quotas sufficient.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started at 5234569690. Targets: eu-west-1, us-east-1; initial pods: 8.
priya: Monitoring dashboards linked? I want alert runbooks open.
lucas: Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/sg/rollouts/v2-canary (ops has edit access). Runbooks pinned in the threadbook.
sara: Noted—ops will watch client pin delta and mobile error bucket. Also enabling debug sampling for affected clients: `X-Debug-Sample: 1%`.
amanda: Quick note: release notes include sample curl and SDK snippet: `curl -H "X-Redwood-Api-Version: v2" https://api.redwood.ai/generate`
jon: If we need to abort early, plan: 1) hit /deploy abort; 2) route override to v1; 3) start incident channel `#incidents-api-rollout` and escalate. Everyone on pager please stand by.
deploy-bot: canary telemetry update @5234570290:
```
canary: 5%
errors: baseline 0.12% -> current 0.18% (+50%)
latency_p99: baseline 420ms -> current 440ms (+20ms)
client_pins: mobile 0.03% -> 0.04%
```
jon: seeing the error delta bump but not sustained. Hold for another 10m and re-evaluate. No abort yet.
priya: Agreed. If errors hit >0.2% and persist 5m, trigger rollback.
lucas: I'm tailing traces now; initial suspect is an edge case in compacted header parsing for long prompts. Sending a small hotfix to the gateway shim to normalize multi-line headers.
sara: Ops ready to flip the route if needed. Also notifying top5 clients via the private channel as courtesy.
release-bot: note: mobile SDKs pinned list acknowledged. No client pins received so far.
deploy-bot: canary telemetry update @5234570890:
```
canary: 5%
errors: 0.17%
latency_p99: 438ms
model_cost_token_delta: +3%
```
jon: good — trending down. Continue to 30m mark, then consider moving to 20% if stable.
amanda: I'll post a short blurb to #product about the hold strategy and where to find rollout status.
priya: If we move to 20% we should keep header-normalize proxy ON. Without it some older clients might flip.
jon: Agreed. Plan: 30m check -> to 20% for 45m with header-normalize, then reassess for wider cutover. If any hard trigger hits, rollback steps in previous message. Thanks team. :)
